body:
Bundle of small list-surface polish items, all in the name of "the Android app
should be perfect":
- ItemRow (ui/list/ListScreen.kt) renders only name + price. Quantity — the
  thing you most need while standing in the store ("2l milk") — is not shown
  (web shows quantity · price). Show quantity, and the note (secondary line,
  ellipsized) since notes like "the ripe ones" only matter in-store.
- Checked strikethrough uses hardcoded Color.Red — poor contrast in dark
  theme; use MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error (web equivalent uses a
  theme-aware danger color).
- Registry status chip shows raw wire strings ("todo"/"backlog"); use
  user-facing labels ("To buy"/"Done"/"Backlog" or similar).
- Settings theme chips show raw enum names SYSTEM/LIGHT/DARK; humanize.
- Overview: activeLists() is unordered (rowid order); sort by name like web,
  or most-recently-used.
- Login screen: email field lacks KeyboardType.Email/ime Next->Done flow; no
  show-password toggle; Column isn't scrollable (small screens + keyboard).
Files: ListScreen.kt, RegistryScreen.kt, SettingsScreen.kt, Daos.kt
(activeLists ORDER BY), LoginScreen.kt.
title: Android list rows: show quantity/note; fix hardcoded red; assorted row/label polish
